scope: Independent execution of Agent A's executable plan against Agent B's isolated local HTTP candidate and actual runner-owned PostgreSQL V78.
countRule: Counts are named Node test cases, not matrix assertions, request totals or accumulated repeated runs. The unchanged five pure contract tests are reused; prior successful journal/restart evidence is not rerun or included in these counts.

findings.observed: Source used HTTP400 for unsupported content type/encoding instead of A's HTTP415.
findings.resolution: B corrected to HTTP415 invalid_request; C06 final actual HTTP415 with zero store calls.

findings.observed: A thrown receipt adapter exception was mapped to HTTP422 instead of the specified HTTP503 receipt_unavailable.
findings.resolution: B separated technical adapter failure from invalid descriptor/binding. C10 confirms technical HTTP503, invalid binding HTTP422 and zero financial calls.

findings.observed: A review required uncertain COMMIT or failed ROLLBACK to discard the client; release errors must not mask the intended response.
findings.resolution: B added quarantine and guarded release. C12/C13/C18 verify uncertain commits and failed rollback discard; ordinary successful rollback can reuse; release error preserves Unknown.

findings.observed: After valid unique Partner reassignment, retained status returned HTTP503 command_unavailable; original submit returned HTTP409.
findings.resolution: A settled HTTP403 access_denied for SQL42501 only before COMMIT after confirmed rollback. B corrected catch classification; C04 and C19 final pass, preserving unavailable on failed cleanup.

findings.observed: Initial C04 fixture failed with SQLSTATE23505 because V25 enforces unique normalized Partner login email.
findings.resolution: A approved preserving insert/update uniqueness assertions and a labelled mapping-query returned-row seam for defensive ambiguity denial. Real constraints remained intact.

independentCases.expected: HTTP200 only for committed Posted, exact Notes/server actor and 330 posted, one journal/payment, fresh authenticated status, diagnostic/security/CORS headers.
independentCases.actual: Actual HTTP200; exact source fields and status agreed; one journal and one payment; two revocation-requesting verifications.

independentCases.expected: Wrong claims, revoked/malformed authentication deny before store; pinned identity configuration mandatory.
independentCases.actual: Twelve cryptographic-verifier seam calls requested revocation=true; all negative requests denied; zero store calls and zero command effects; invalid pinned configuration rejected.

independentCases.expected: Actor, Partner, hash, reference, issuer and status injection keys rejected.
independentCases.actual: Six body-injection variants returned HTTP400 before store; no command effects.

independentCases.expected: Missing/ambiguous mapping denies; real normalized duplicates prohibited; legal Partner reassignment conflicts on known submit and denies retained status.
independentCases.actual: Missing mapping HTTP403 both verbs; duplicate insert/update SQLSTATE23505 with original mapping preserved; two-row query-result seam HTTP403 without journal/status/submit SQL; remapped POST409 and GET403 access_denied; one original effect.

independentCases.expected: Exact origins/preflight/routes/verbs/UUIDs; missing Origin permitted for authenticated nonbrowser request.
independentCases.actual: Invalid origins rejected before authentication, route/preflight boundaries passed; raw no-Origin authenticated GET returned HTTP200; rejected routes never submitted.

independentCases.expected: Unsupported media/encoding HTTP415, invalid UTF-8 HTTP400, streamed actual-byte oversize HTTP413.
independentCases.actual: All response classifications passed with zero store calls and zero command effects.

independentCases.expected: Stalled body times out within bounded 5-second budget; abort before complete body never submits.
independentCases.actual: Stalled body HTTP400 at approximately five seconds; premature abort produced zero submit calls.

independentCases.expected: Identical concurrent UUID retries one effect; changed identity conflicts; competing IDs never double post.
independentCases.actual: Four identical requests returned original committed result with one effect; changed Notes/amount/selection HTTP409 without original payload; competing IDs produced one Posted and one technical Unknown, one journal/payment total.

independentCases.expected: Durable typed date/account rejection preserved by status/retry; absent status unresolved; empty Notes canonicalizes to null.
independentCases.actual: Invalid date/missing account HTTP422 with journal only; GET200 and retry retained original rejection. Absent status unresolved. Empty/null Notes posted/replayed as canonical null.

independentCases.expected: Default unsupported receipt fail closed; invalid owner/request/receipt/shape binding no submit; adapter technical failure unavailable.
independentCases.actual: Absent resolver receipt_unsupported; four binding/shape variants HTTP422 with zero financial SQL; thrown adapter HTTP503 receipt_unavailable, zero effects.

independentCases.expected: Retained receipt replay avoids current resolver but requires current actor mapping.
independentCases.actual: Valid synthetic immutable descriptor posted once; exact retry with throwing resolver retained Posted; changed receipt ID409; missing current mapping403; no repost.

independentCases.expected: Injected acknowledgement loss after real COMMIT returns Unknown and same-ID fresh status recovers original.
independentCases.actual: HTTP503 command_outcome_unknown; fresh authenticated status and exact retry found same Posted; one journal/payment.

independentCases.expected: Failure before financial attempt unavailable; attempted submission with failed pre-commit acknowledgement Unknown and atomic rollback.
independentCases.actual: Acquisition failure HTTP503 command_unavailable; COMMIT seam failure after submit HTTP503 command_outcome_unknown; discard=true; rollback left zero journal/payment; status unresolved.

independentCases.expected: Abort after financial execution begins requires same-ID status recovery, without automatic retry.
independentCases.actual: Actual HTTP disconnect after submit query begins; bounded completion and authenticated status retained Posted; exactly one financial submit and one effect.

independentCases.expected: Journal original independent of corrected/deleted current source.
independentCases.actual: Synthetic governed source correction then deletion left replay/status original unchanged; journal remained one, source payment zero; no recreation.
Six metadata-result seams returned command_unavailable with zero financial SQL; invalid directory/origin configuration rejected; no fallback or command effects.

independentCases.expected: Sanitized completion keys and logger failure cannot change outcome.
independentCases.actual: Only approved keys/enum/diagnostic fields; no sensitive IDs, notes, credentials or identity values captured. Throwing logger preserved committed POST/status.

independentCases.expected: Discard COMMIT/rollback faults; release failure preserves intended Unknown; successful rollback may reuse.
independentCases.actual: Failed rollback discard=true; pre-commit fault plus throwing release remained command_outcome_unknown; ordinary rollback discard=false; no partial effects.

independentCases.expected: SQL42501 before COMMIT becomes access denial only after confirmed rollback.
independentCases.actual: Confirmed rollback HTTP403 access_denied with release(false); failed rollback HTTP503 command_unavailable with release(true); zero financial calls and existing original effect retained.

boundaries: Cryptographic Firebase verification is an injected synthetic test dependency; actual Firebase signature/revocation service behavior and actual owner token/session are not established.
Defensive ambiguous mapping and guard failures use labelled query-result seams over actual guarded local clients. Real V25 unique constraints remain in place.
COMMIT acknowledgement loss and cleanup failures are injected transport/pool seams. Tests do not claim a physical network-failure experiment.
Receipt descriptors are synthetic trusted-adapter fixtures; no GCS write, live bytes/ownership proof, AppSheet image roundtrip or iPhone HEIC compatibility is established.
V78 remains immutable and is applied only to fresh disposable databases. Live DEV/PROD remain outside this work.
No Cloud Run/Hosting/Firebase/IAM/role/grant/notification/financial activation or frontend/4B preview change was performed.
No live least-privilege, committed-event delivery, browser/OS readiness or production safety claim. D owns database CI, final source pin and publication.
